_comment: OPEN search, -3000/+1000 Da. POSITIVE CONTROL ONLY -- not the primary metric.
Exists solely to make the 4->2 charge error visible. The envelope arm has 10,199 known 4->2
confusions; each fabricates dM = (2-4)(m/z - 1.00728), i.e. -1000 to -2800 Da over the observed
m/z range. A +-500 window does not report them AT ALL, so a benchmark run only at +-500 cannot
detect the failure mode it was built to detect.
This window is expensive (candidate space scales with it) and its FDR is correspondingly less
trustworthy -- which is exactly why entrapment, not target-decoy, is the FDR estimator here.
